title: NVDA unveils new inference chip lineup
body: Chipmaker NVDA announced a new inference accelerator family, claiming 2x throughput per watt for datacenter LLM serving.

title: AAPL services revenue hits record
body: AAPL services segment posted record quarterly revenue, driven by subscriptions and payment volume growth.

title: TSLA recalls 40k vehicles over sensor fault
body: TSLA issued a voluntary recall covering 40,000 vehicles after a driver-monitoring sensor fault was traced to a supplier batch.

title: BTC ETF inflows reach weekly high
body: Spot BTC ETFs recorded their largest weekly net inflow since launch, led by two institutional issuers.

title: MSFT cloud growth beats estimates
body: MSFT reported cloud revenue above consensus, with AI workload demand cited as the primary driver.

title: Analysts raise NVDA price targets
body: Three brokerages raised NVDA price targets after the inference chip announcement, citing datacenter backlog visibility.

title: ETH staking yield compresses
body: ETH staking yields fell to a six-month low as validator count climbed and network fees declined.

title: AAPL supplier warns of component shortage
body: A key AAPL component supplier flagged a two-quarter shortage, raising questions about holiday-quarter unit availability.

title: TSLA margins stabilize in Q3 filing
body: TSLA quarterly filing showed gross margin stabilization after six quarters of compression, helped by lower battery input costs.

title: MSFT opens new datacenter region
body: MSFT brought a new cloud datacenter region online, its fourth this year, citing enterprise AI demand.

title: NVDA supply chain adds second assembler
body: NVDA qualified a second systems assembler for its inference line, easing a bottleneck that constrained Q3 shipments.

title: Miners expand ahead of difficulty adjustment
body: Large BTC miners added hashrate ahead of next week's difficulty adjustment, betting on sustained fee revenue.

title: GOOGL ad revenue recovery continues
body: GOOGL advertising revenue grew for a third consecutive quarter, with retail and travel verticals leading.

title: AMD wins datacenter CPU contract
body: AMD secured a multi-year datacenter CPU supply agreement with a top-three cloud provider, according to people familiar with the deal.

title: AMZN logistics costs fall
body: AMZN reported lower per-unit logistics costs as regionalization of its fulfillment network reached 90% coverage.

title: META open-sources new language model
body: META released weights for a new mid-size language model, claiming parity with proprietary systems on standard benchmarks.

title: ETH L2 fees drop after upgrade
body: Transaction fees on major ETH layer-2 networks fell sharply following a data-availability upgrade.

title: NVDA datacenter bookings extend into 2027
body: NVDA told investors datacenter bookings now extend into 2027, underscoring persistent accelerator scarcity.

title: TSLA energy storage deployments double
body: TSLA energy storage deployments doubled year over year, making energy its fastest-growing segment.

title: AAPL announces mixed-reality refresh
body: AAPL announced a refreshed mixed-reality headset with a lighter frame and a lower entry price.

title: SOL network activity hits yearly high

title: MSFT security unit signs government deal
body: MSFT security division signed a multi-year government contract covering endpoint and identity protection.

title: Regulators open probe into GOOGL ad tech
body: Antitrust regulators opened a formal probe into GOOGL advertising technology stack practices.

title: AMD raises full-year guidance

title: AMZN ad business outpaces retail growth

title: BTC volatility drops to quarterly low
body: Realized volatility in BTC fell to its lowest level this quarter as options markets priced a quiet November.

body: New EU rules will restrict META ad targeting on sensitive categories starting next year, the company said.
